Requirements You are in @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.vNck1Oor9udzoSRj]{Storm Surge Stance}.

Your weapon sparks with your aspect, its glare throwing your opponent off. You Strike. If your attack hits, the target needs to make a @Check[fortitude|against:class-spell] save to resist an additional effect:

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target is blinded for 4 rounds. It can make a Fortitude save at the end of their turns to reduce the duration by 1 round.

If you have the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.8ad23sFdfBpqwklz]{Aspect of Skies}, your motes cause your strike to generate a sonic boom, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafening} your target for the same duration as the blindness on a failure or a critical failure; this is an auditory effect. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.pid3Nv3o23ilx3n6]{Aspect of Tides}, your watery motes reflect the flash to enemies adjacent to your target, forcing them to also make a Fortitude saving throw.
